verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say code review supports the Pull Request workflow (plus the AGit workflow). They also say maintainers can review and merge code submissions, and submitters can respond to review comments and modify code online. That covers proposing changes back for review and merge. However, no evidence explicitly documents forking a repository or cross-repository pull requests from outside contributors' forks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repository forking and fork-based cross-repo pull requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the outside-contributor PR flow.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can let outside contributors fork my repository and propose changes back via pull requests

citations.quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow.
Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
